name: Barbell JM Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench with feet planted, take a shoulder-width overhand grip on the barbell, and unrack it over your upper chest.
Retract your shoulder blades into the pad and lock your wrists straight.
Bend your elbows and let them travel slightly forward as you lower the bar smoothly toward your chin or upper chest.
Stop a few inches above your upper chest and drive powerfully through your triceps to extend back to lockout.
tips: Reverse the descent cleanly well clear of your throat and face.
Keep your wrists rigid and stacked rather than letting the bar bend your hands backward.
